subtext.hi: FTA se leke Irrational proofs tak — sab ek saath practice karo.
subtext.en: From FTA to irrational proofs — practice it all together.

text.hi: Board exam mein Real Numbers se aksar HCF/LCM word problems aur irrational proof pooche jaate hain.
text.en: Board exams often ask HCF/LCM word problems and irrational proofs from Real Numbers.

content.hi: 1. Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic: har composite number ka unique prime factorization hota hai.
content.en: 1. Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic: every composite number has a unique prime factorization.

content.hi: 2. HCF = common primes ki smallest power, LCM = saare primes ki largest power.
content.en: 2. HCF = smallest power of common primes, LCM = largest power of all primes.

content.hi: 3. Irrational proof: rational assume karo → contradiction dikhao → irrational hai.
content.en: 3. Irrational proof: assume rational → show a contradiction → it's irrational.

problem.hi: Do buses 60 min aur 90 min mein ek round trip karti hain. Agar dono 8 AM ko saath start hui, to wo dobara saath kab milengi?
problem.en: Two buses take 60 min and 90 min for a round trip. If both start together at 8 AM, when will they meet again?

steps.hi: Ye LCM ka question hai: LCM(60,90)
steps.en: This is an LCM question: LCM(60,90)

steps.hi: Answer: 11 AM ko dobara saath milengi
steps.en: Answer: They'll meet again at 11 AM

question.hi: Teen bells 6, 8, aur 12 minute ke gaps par bajti hain. Wo dobara ek saath kitne minute baad bajengi?
question.en: Three bells ring every 6, 8, and 12 minutes. After how many minutes will they ring together again?

question.hi: Concept ko uski definition se match karo
question.en: Match the concept to its definition
What kind of number is π (pi)?

explanation.hi: π ka decimal na terminate karta hai na repeat — ye irrational hai.
explanation.en: π's decimal neither terminates nor repeats — it's irrational.

notes.hi: HCF/LCM word problems mein 'saath milna' → LCM, 'max equal groups' → HCF
notes.en: In HCF/LCM word problems, 'meeting together' → LCM, 'max equal groups' → HCF

notes.hi: Irrational proof ka structure yaad rakho: assume rational → contradiction → conclude irrational
notes.en: Remember the irrational proof structure: assume rational → contradiction → conclude irrational

summary.en: Real Numbers chapter complete! You can now confidently solve FTA, HCF/LCM, and irrational proof problems.
